name: Main Gate (Gate No. 1)
description: Primary ceremonial and vehicular entrance to NIT Jalandhar situated on the Grand Trunk Road (Amritsar Bypass / NH-44). Regulated with 24x7 security personnel, boom barriers, and visitor registration.

name: Administrative Block
description: Principal administrative nerve center of NIT Jalandhar. Houses the Office of the Director, Deputy Director, Registrar, Deans (Academic, Planning & Development, Student Welfare, Research & Consultancy), and Academic Section.

name: Central Seminar Hall
description: State-of-the-art auditorium and lecture symposium venue dedicated to institute convocations, international technical conferences, national symposiums, and cultural addresses.

name: Central Library / Knowledge Centre
description: Multi-story Knowledge Centre housing more than 100,000 physical volumes, subscriptions to leading digital databases (IEEE, Springer, ScienceDirect), e-learning cubicles, research scholar reading zones, and book-bank services.

name: Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
description: One of the flagship departments of NIT Jalandhar. Accommodates advanced computing infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning laboratories, Data Science clusters, and departmental faculty suites.
operatingHours: 08:30 AM - 05:30 PM (Lab access extended for research)

name: Department of Information Technology (IT)
description: Houses high-end software development labs, cyber-security suites, cloud computing facilities, and multi-tier classroom environments.

name: Department of Civil Engineering
description: Premier department featuring specialized structural engineering testing rigs, concrete technology yards, geotechnical engineering laboratories, surveying equipment storage, and environmental engineering testing setups.

name: Lecture Hall Complex (LHC) & AKAM Lecture Theatre
description: Central multi-tiered academic complex hosting common undergraduate lectures, the modern AKAM (Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav) Lecture Theatre, and central examination halls equipped with audio-visual presentation consoles.

name: Student Activity Centre (SAC)
description: Nerve center of student campus life, recreation, and indoor sports. Houses a fully equipped modern gym, indoor wooden badminton courts, table tennis room, chess and carrom halls, dance studio, and student club rooms.

name: Mega Boys Hostel Complex (MBH)
description: Extensive high-rise residential complex comprising Blocks A, B, E, and F, accommodating hundreds of senior scholars. Features dedicated dining mess halls, reading rooms, indoor recreational areas, and late-night tuck points.

name: Mega Girls Hostel Complex
description: State-of-the-art secure residential high-rise for female engineering students and scholars. Includes in-house dining mess, indoor sports courts, study halls, and biometric access controls.

name: Campus Shopping Centre & Commercial Complex
description: Campus commercial plaza providing essential provisions: general stores, laundry & dry cleaning, stationery shop, high-speed photocopying, thesis binding, tailoring, and haircutting salon.

name: Canara Bank Branch & 24x7 ATM
description: On-campus institutional bank branch of Canara Bank providing full retail banking, fee collection, educational loans, and 24x7 ATM cash withdrawals.

name: State Bank of India (SBI) Branch & ATM
description: State Bank of India branch and automated teller facility located near the Guest House and Shopping Complex, catering to institute salary accounts and student transactions.

name: Institute Dispensary & Health Centre
description: 24/7 campus medical facility providing primary healthcare, physician consultation, pathology lab tests, observation beds, minor emergency procedures, and around-the-clock emergency ambulance transport.

name: Campus Post Office (Dispensary Annex)
description: Official branch post office of India Post located inside the dispensary building. Handles Speed Post, registered letters, parcels, packaging, and postal banking services (Pincode: 144008 / 144011).

name: Campus Canteen
description: Central dining cafeteria serving hot meals, thalis, North and South Indian specialties, parathas, dosas, tea, coffee, and quick snacks during institute hours.

name: Food Point (Near Biotechnology Block)
description: Popular student food court situated close to the Biotechnology Department. Known for quick bites, rolls, shakes, beverages, and casual outdoor seating.

name: Institute Guest House & Mega Guest House
description: Premier institutional hospitality lodge featuring furnished air-conditioned VIP suites, dining halls, conference lounges, and landscaped lawns for visiting experts, examiners, and delegates.

name: Central Sports Ground & Athletic Track
description: Full-size standard 400-meter clay/cinder running track encircling the central football ground, with adjacent cricket turf wickets and athletic field facilities.
